info.title: CRM in Cloud Universal API
info.description: CRM in Cloud is TeamSystem's CRM platform for managing companies, contacts, leads, opportunities, activities, quotes, orders, and related sales workflows.

get.description: Retrieves the number of activities in CRM in Cloud.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

value.description: Count returned by CRM in Cloud.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
